record: S3.2 of docs/roadmap/19-ai-strategy-improvement-wbs.md: is error list E6 (attacking units stopping two or three hexes short of a defended target they could reach) an error under heuristic@86? Registered before any continuation is run
branches: branches.jsonl: the attacker's first Movement decision of Game Turn 2 in every recorded game of 2100400-2100479 and 2100100-2100179 (160)

variants.approach: heuristic:approach-weights.json (approachAttack 1: a unit of no theater group closes in beside its defended ASSAULT, HUNT or CAPTURE target without the crowding and exposure penalties)

horizons: T0+1 and the end of the game
measures: approach - none for the attacker, dice averaged per branch, mean and SE over branch points (scripts/ai-continue-compare.py): margin.vp and margin.killLoss at the end
decision: E6 is an error, and approachAttack goes on to the S3 check, if VP margin or Kill - Loss has mean - 2.1 x SE > 0 and the other has mean - 2.1 x SE > -1.5
E6 is not an error if neither improves so; approachAttack is then removed and recorded as tried and not adopted
powerAnalysis: E5's continuations (27 positions x 4 dice) had per-position SDs of about 4 for Kill - Loss and 2.5 for VP; with 160 branches and 2 dice the SE is about 0.4 and 0.25, so a true improvement of 1 step Kill - Loss or 0.6 VP is found with probability about 0.8.
